source: Emmre's Full Offline Research, Writing, and Translation Skill Catalog (24 categories, 288 skills)
notes: Each skill maps to one operation of this Skill Tool.
Run a skill with: python3 tools-offline-research.py apply --skill <id> [--input path] [--set key=value]
Operations that depend on a local model adapter fail with exit code 4 when no adapter is configured.
